title: Seoul denies helping ease Russia fuel shortage

blocks.text: South Korea on Wednesday rejected claims that petroleum shipments from South Korean ports helped Russia ease a fuel shortage caused by Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries. Presidential spokesperson Kang Yu-jung said in a written statement that Seoul has consistently implemented sanctions and export controls against Russia in close coordination with the international community since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. “There has been no change in this position of our government,” Kang added.
